issue_A.diagnosis: The table rates (7.29, 22.77) come from pooled concatenated strings (truncated to 200k symbols, prose[:40000]); the 3.18 ratio comes from a different per-unit aggregation on prose[:20000]. Two different estimators on different samples, not an arithmetic error.

issue_B.diagnosis: 192 verses carry one of the five endings; 2 were dropped because no content lemma remained after removing the last 3 words and divine names (very short verses). Not duplicates.

issue_C.note: Original accuracy 0.815 is pooled accuracy on an imbalanced test set (majority 0.676), compared in the report to 50%. Quran chunks were built by concatenating quotes then randomly split -> identical quoted verses (quoted many times across collections) appear in both train and test (leakage). Revised in experiments/exp5_stylometry.py.
